description: Election Commission - A member of the Alayadivembu P/S has vacated his office (of member of that P/S)
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party, as declared by the Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content is directly related to electoral processes and the status of an elected official, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
